notablePrerequisites: Your opponents control at least seven artifacts and/or enchantments.
description:
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, targeting Dockside Extortionist.
Holding priority, cast Reiterate with buyback by paying {4}{R}{R}, creating a copy of Emphemerate.
Resolve the Emphemerate copy, blinking Dockside Extortionist, creating at least seven Treasure tokens.
Holding priority, activate six Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing those, adding {R}{R} and four mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.
